title: Civica SNAP test-profile requires[] taxonomy
description: Authoritative enumeration of engine-surface tags emitted by civica_test_profiles_generator.py's requires_for(). Every tag a profile declares MUST appear in this file; conversely, every surface listed here MUST be implementable by the engine to pass profiles that declare it. The JSON Schema enforces requires.items.enum against the keys of this object.

test.gross_net_fpl.description: The gross/net income tests at federal FPL multiples (130%, 100% net, or BBCE-200%). Every profile declares this.

test.net_only.description: Net-income-only test (E/D households skip gross). Triggered when household has elderly or disabled member.

eligibility.student.description: Higher-education student eligibility (he_* status enum + exemptions: work20, single_parent_child_under12, work_study, et_placement, age50plus, dependent_under6, tanf).

eligibility.immigration.description: Immigration-status eligibility incl. citizen/LPR/refugee/asylee/COFA/undocumented, five-year-bar, 40-quarters exemption, refugee_adjusted, removed_status (post-OBBBA).

eligibility.disqualification.description: Member-level disqualifications: lottery winnings, IPV, fleeing felon, drug felony (state option).

eligibility.categorical.description: Categorical eligibility via pure_SSI, pure_PA, or BBCE conferral. Skips asset test; may skip gross test.

household.composition.description: Household-composition edges: roomer (separate HH), boarder (combine), sponsored alien, must-combine-with-parent under 22, treatment-center resident as one-person HH, migrant.

workreq.abawd.description: ABAWD work requirement: 3-in-36 month clock, exemptions (caregiver_incapacitated, disabled, veteran_homeless pre-OBBBA, Tribal post-OBBBA), area waivers, jury duty good cause.

income.wages.description: Earned wage income (excluding self-employment). Triggers 20% earned-income deduction.

income.unearned.description: Unearned income: RSDI, SSI, TANF, UI, gift_cash, contract_seasonal. Does NOT get EID.

income.self_employment.description: Self-employment + farm self-employment (with loss-offset rules). State-option calc method.

income.exclusion.description: Income exclusions: AmeriCorps state/national (always excluded), AmeriCorps VISTA (conditional on prior SNAP), tax refund/EITC, vendor payments to landlord.

shelter.sua.HCSUA.description: Heating/cooling SUA tier. Per-state production value via PARAMS.sua_by_state.

shelter.uncapped.description: Excess-shelter deduction uncapped for households with elderly or disabled member.

shelter.homeless.description: Homeless-household shelter deduction substitute ($198.99 FY26) in lieu of excess-shelter calc.

deductions.medical.description: Elderly/disabled medical-expense deduction above the $35 floor.
